title: Bio-STG-MetaNet: Bio-Spatio-Temporal Graph and Gated Meta-Classification Architecture for EEG Alcoholism Detection
description: Official codebase for Bio-STG-MetaNet, an end-to-end neuro-geometric deep learning architecture incorporating 3D spherical electrode distance priors (BioDGATLayer), tri-band frequency decomposition, spatio-temporal residual convolutions, bidirectional recurrence with multi-head attention, and gated meta-classification for Alcohol Use Disorder (AUD) detection from 64-channel scalp EEG.

creators.name: Chandel, Vishal
